One year ago, when I purchased my bike, I was considering either PPF or ceramic coating. While searching online, I came across Splash Car and Bike Wash. Honestly, I was a bit skeptical at first because of the many 5-star reviews, but I decided to check it out—and I quickly understood why this place is rated so highly.
Sujit, is a great person and extremely knowledgeable. He helped me decide what would work best for my bike based on my usage and patiently explained the products and services in detail. The work done was absolutely top-notch.
Even a year later, when it was time for the annual maintenance of the coating, the team was very professional and accommodating.
Attached are photos of my one-year-old bike after its annual maintenance service.
Would 100% recommend Splash Car and Bike Wash to anyone looking for quality work and honest guidance.
